title: FIL Frame To Pixels
text: Convert frame-based video to pixel stream for FPGA-in-the-loop, 1 input, 6 outputs, {Output vector format} sets Size of vector used to communicate with FPGA subsystem; {Number of components} sets the number of values used to represent each, {Number of pixels} and {Video format} sets the dimensions of active and inactive regions in video frame. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: hStartOut
ports.summary: First pixel in horizontal line of frame vector

ports.name: hEndOut
ports.summary: Last pixel in horizontal line of frame vector

ports.name: vStartOut
ports.summary: First pixel in first (top) line of frame vector

ports.name: vEndOut
ports.summary: Last pixel in last (bottom) line of frame vector

params.name: Number of components
params.values: Number of values used to represent each pixel 1 (default) | 3 | 4

params.name: Number of pixels
params.values: Number of pixels in each column of output matrix 1 (default) | 2 | 4 | 8

params.name: Output vector format
params.values: Size of vector used to communicate with FPGA subsystem Frame (default) | Line | Pixel

params.name: Video format
params.values: Dimensions of active and inactive regions in video frame 1080p (default) | 240p | 480p | 480pH | 576p | 720p | 768p | 1024p | 1200p | 2KCinema | 4KUHDTV | 8KUHDTV | Custom
